lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I'm a music lover who

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: chase after those from centuries past.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: I'm having this problem,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: so I'm hoping someone of your caliber can assist me.
What is it?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: My teacher is getting on in years.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: In his time on the surface, he witnessed the sunrise and sunset more times than there are stars in the sky.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: All the while, he played music that was fast disappearing.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: But now, with the passing of time,

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: the years have caught up with him, and his legs are not what they used to be.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: As his protégé, it pains me to see him like this.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Could you help him walk again?
I'm not a doctor.
What exactly do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: That's fine, but you can entrust this matter to Julia.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: She is the one who best knows

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: how to breathe life back into my instructor.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: You can leave all of that to Julia.

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: Please, I need you to bring my instructor up to the surface

lines.speaker: musiclover
lines.text: where he used to play his music.
I can do that.
